                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>

                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>

                </executions>
            </plugin>

              title: Member ID
              description: The unified member identifier, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with
                no separators. REGION is the region code derived from the postcode/city (NSW, VIC,
                QLD or UNKNOWN); FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the same YY as fiscalYear); HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone +
                lastName); and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. A trailing '-<n>' is appended on collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for a household, computed deterministically
                as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedLastName + '|' +
                postcode). Every owner is assigned one, and owners sharing a lastName and postcode
                share the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f8a1c2d9e0b'
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are preferred
            and 'address' is returned as the composed normalized string. Optional when a structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            abbreviations expanded) like the flat address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER
            a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit,
            level, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted as digits with
            optional spaces, dashes, brackets and a leading '+'; stored in
            E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be four digits and, when the city maps to a known
            region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099),
            must fall within that region's inclusive range. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand' against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permit creating this owner even though another owner
            already belongs to the same household (same lastName and postcode; they knowingly
            share a household). Write-only; used only to bypass the household-duplicate check
            and not stored. The householdId itself is always computed from lastName and postcode.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as 'title lastName' when a title is
                supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The unified member identifier, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with
                no separators. REGION is the region code derived from the postcode/city (NSW, VIC,
                QLD or UNKNOWN); FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the same YY as fiscalYear); HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone +
                lastName); and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. A trailing '-<n>' is appended on collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for a household, computed deterministically
                as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedLastName + '|' +
                postcode). Every owner is assigned one, and owners sharing a lastName and postcode
                share the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f8a1c2d9e0b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key used for duplicate detection, the lower-case
                hex SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email
                segment is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '3f8a1c2d9e0b4a5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899aabbccddeeff0011223344'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The membership points scored at creation. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an
                email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or
                more; adds 3 when at least one fiscal year has elapsed since registration.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The numeric membership level (1 to 4) derived from membershipPoints;
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
                Level 4 requires the tenure factor, which a newly created owner never has.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is
                not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region using a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's details.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard identity duplicate but shares an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode (with a different telephone) at the moment
                it was created, otherwise false. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode). Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the moment this owner was created, signalling the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate,
                when a birthDate was supplied. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year's start-year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-or-later date takes that calendar year and a
                January-to-June date takes the previous one (e.g. 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 is
                'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when at least one risk signal holds for this owner - it is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (related to a known
                disposable-mail provider), or its city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
            - bulkSignupWarning
            - riskFlag

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are preferred
            and 'address' is returned as the composed normalized string. Optional when a structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            abbreviations expanded) like the flat address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER
            a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit,
            level, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted as digits with
            optional spaces, dashes, brackets and a leading '+'; stored in
            E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be four digits and, when the city maps to a known
            region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099),
            must fall within that region's inclusive range. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand' against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permit creating this owner even though another owner
            already belongs to the same household (same lastName and postcode; they knowingly
            share a household). Write-only; used only to bypass the household-duplicate check
            and not stored. The householdId itself is always computed from lastName and postcode.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as 'title lastName' when a title is
                supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract. Version 2 groups the
                memberId, householdId and identityKey under the 'identity' object and rederives
                each identifier with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: The owner's version-2 derived identity — the memberId, householdId and
                identityKey, each rederived with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in so every value
                differs from its version-1 form. The V2 tag appears only inside these identifiers,
                never in the user-facing locality, timezone or owner segment.
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key used for duplicate detection, the lower-case
                hex SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email
                segment is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '3f8a1c2d9e0b4a5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899aabbccddeeff0011223344'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The membership points scored at creation. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an
                email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or
                more; adds 3 when at least one fiscal year has elapsed since registration.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The numeric membership level (1 to 4) derived from membershipPoints;
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
                Level 4 requires the tenure factor, which a newly created owner never has.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is
                not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region using a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's details.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard identity duplicate but shares an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode (with a different telephone) at the moment
                it was created, otherwise false. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode). Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the moment this owner was created, signalling the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate,
                when a birthDate was supplied. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year's start-year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-or-later date takes that calendar year and a
                January-to-June date takes the previous one (e.g. 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 is
                'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when at least one risk signal holds for this owner - it is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (related to a known
                disposable-mail provider), or its city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
            - bulkSignupWarning
            - riskFlag

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are preferred
            and 'address' is returned as the composed normalized string. Optional when a structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            abbreviations expanded) like the flat address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER
            a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit,
            level, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted as digits with
            optional spaces, dashes, brackets and a leading '+'; stored in
            E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be four digits and, when the city maps to a known
            region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099),
            must fall within that region's inclusive range. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand' against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permit creating this owner even though another owner
            already belongs to the same household (same lastName and postcode; they knowingly
            share a household). Write-only; used only to bypass the household-duplicate check
            and not stored. The householdId itself is always computed from lastName and postcode.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as 'title lastName' when a title is
                supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract. Version 2 groups the
                memberId, householdId and identityKey under the 'identity' object and rederives
                each identifier with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: The owner's version-2 derived identity — the memberId, householdId and
                identityKey, each rederived with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in so every value
                differs from its version-1 form. The V2 tag appears only inside these identifiers,
                never in the user-facing locality, timezone or owner segment.
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The membership points scored at creation. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an
                email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or
                more; adds 3 when at least one fiscal year has elapsed since registration.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The numeric membership level (1 to 4) derived from membershipPoints;
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
                Level 4 requires the tenure factor, which a newly created owner never has.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is
                not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region using a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's details.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard identity duplicate but shares an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode (with a different telephone) at the moment
                it was created, otherwise false. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode). Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the moment this owner was created, signalling the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate,
                when a birthDate was supplied. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year's start-year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-or-later date takes that calendar year and a
                January-to-June date takes the previous one (e.g. 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 is
                'FY26').

                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.

                otherwise false.

      title: Owner identity
      description: The owner's version-2 derived identity. Each identifier is rederived with a fixed
        'V2' version tag mixed in, so no value equals its version-1 form.
      type: object
      properties:

            appended on collision.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW261A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true

            value automatically.

            SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)|V2' (the email segment is

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

        description: The pet owner

          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

      responses:

          description: The pet owner was successfully added.

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:

          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string

          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
